meaning:
ὀστράκινος -η, -ον
(ὄστρακον, an earthen vessel or potsherd), [in LXX chiefly for חֶרֶשׂ ;]
made of clay, earthen: 2Co.4:7, 2Ti.2:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.
Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor, and some for dishonor.
